answer: Guarantor admission plus reputation decay blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer needs an agent to stake 50 copper tokens, and its reputation decays 10% each epoch unless honest work renews it, like a river without fresh flow. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 guarantors and 50,000 copper, while each earns at most 20 POA a month, so cost beats gain. If one cheats, its guarantor is slashed too. No fable: an honest identity pays once and keeps its earnings.
